description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Differential Oil Level Plug & Gasket for the Rear Differential Case / Axle Housing.
This plug is located on the side of the rear differential case and is taken out to check the level of the differential oil.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Plug
Qty 1 – Gasket
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1990 – 1995 All Models
